note: Front relief: flat back at z = 0, dial faces +z. mm, origin = case and dial centre. Plan sizes from the trace (38.7 mm case, listing); heights estimated for the listed 12.6 mm before the house depth scale (no side view). Dial, subdials, date, print, crystal wall and the tachymeter insert come from one photo map; subdial hands stay printed in it.

bezel.note: thin polished steel edge around the black insert; insert slopes down outward

dial.note: flat dial to the traced dial edge, then the grey crystal wall of the photo as a cone up to the insert

bracelet.note: House curl (SUR419P1): bend at the lug tips (22.6 mm), 7 mm radius, end_y = tip + 2.2 x radius

crystal.note: alpha-blended, not transmission: web viewers blur the dial behind transmission glass. Black base colour keeps the dark dial clear (SRPG18J1)

lume.note: cream lume from the photo (sRGB about 232, 214, 190)

steel_brushed.note: ambientCG Metal009 (CC0) NormalGL 1K; lines run along the bracelet; bevels keep the plain polished material
